records.final_feedback: Candidate faithfully targets ship and case owners, enforces four cases and required evidence/results with correct datatypes and units, validates the four midpoint positions using formula-result-scaled tolerances, and verifies that the reported selected F, Q, and P values are the respective case maxima.

Add a constraint requiring every nltl:hasBowSubregionCalculationCase node to provide bowFormApplicabilityClassification selection evidence before conditional formula evaluation. The current queries only inspect cases explicitly classified nltl:i231vBowFormApplicability, so a linked case with the classification missing silently passes; retain formula enforcement for the controlled applicable value but report missing applicability-selection evidence.

Remove the first two SPARQL constraints: the clause does not require every BI_b/M_b/S_b plate to provide Omega, does not require every Omega>=70 plate to have a classification, and does not permit adding otherIceStrengthenedArea as an applicability alternative. Revise the bounded formula constraint so its applicability reflects the inclusive wording for transversely framed plating (Omega>=70), including the named bottom areas, rather than making the named areas an exclusive intersection that excludes other transversely framed plating. Retain the formula operands on their declared owners and the expected-result-scaled tolerance.

Close the coverage escape for local-frame cases: every ship-linked nltl:localFrameSectionCalculationCase must be validated by the conditional area/direct/interpolation logic and must be consistently linked to its declared structural member through nltl:hasLocalFrameSectionCalculationCase. The current graph validates only cases reached from a ship structural member, so a local-frame case linked through nltl:hasCalculationCase but not reciprocally linked from its member can evade all formula, applicability, and relationship checks.

Remove the unrelated frameProfileType constraint and do not impose xsd:decimal/kN validation on combinedShearAndBendingDemand: its supplied canonical record has no declared quantity kind or recommended unit. Retain the required decimal/kN checks for midspanPlasticCollapseLoad and ship-owned plasticStrength, and compare each represented applicable load-case demand against the tolerance-validated plastic strength.

Replace the sh:or branch that passes solely because nltl:polarClass is absent: missing applicability/branch-selection evidence must not establish non-applicability. Locate and use a canonical explicit non-Polar/non-applicable classification or status alternative, while requiring valid polarClass evidence for the applicable branch and retaining the universal (no structure minCount) constraint over each linked internalIceStrengthenedStructure. Also make qudt:unit exclusive (sh:maxCount 1) in addition to sh:hasValue unit:MilliM so a quantity cannot simultaneously assert a conflicting unit.

No supplied candidate is a verified canonical Ice-free or Other-waters controlled classification value, nor does any candidate fully support the required matrix branch matching and no-training applicability logic.

Remove sh:minCount 1 from nltl:hasThrusterIceImpactLoadCase: the verified comparison model is universal over each linked impact case and does not independently require every targeted ship to assert at least one case. Retain the nested case validation and bounded capacity comparison for every case that is linked.
